verdict.rationale: The firm's materials include an ESOP tax publication on the capital-gains treatment of repurchased employee stock options and a Startup Notification report on recognition thresholds. Neither addresses founder vesting schedules, an 83(b)-equivalent election, or equity splits among co-founders. Employee option taxation is an adjacent topic and earns no credit for founder day-zero ownership setup.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm's own materials cover founder equity mechanics — vesting schedules, 83(b) elections or the local equivalent, and equity splits among co-founders — so day-zero ownership is set up right
